content.title: Jones Soda announces divestiture of cannabis beverage business
content.summary: Jones Soda (JSDA) announced that it has sold its cannabis beverage business, including all related cannabis-specific assets under the Mary Jones brand, to MJ Reg Disrupters, a privately held company. The transaction is part of Jones’ previously announced strategy to streamline operations and focus on its core soda offerings, modern functional beverages, and emerging adult beverage category.
